commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Rafik Messali (Toulouse) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Rafik Messali (Toulouse) commits a foul during an attacking move.
89' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Ben Chilwell (Strasbourg) is given a yellow card.
87' Today's match ends for Diego Moreira who will be replaced by Martial Godo (Strasbourg).
87' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
85' Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg) has tested the patience of referee Stephanie Frappart and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
85' Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
85' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 29:71.
84' Nice passing game by Strasbourg. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
82' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Stephanie Frappart lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
82' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.

80' Strasbourg slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) comes onto the pitch for Emersonn.

78' Emersonn (Toulouse) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
76' A player from Strasbourg commits a rough challenge. Stephanie Frappart blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
75' Here is a change. Guela Doue is going off and Liam Rosenior gives the last tactical orders to Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg).
72' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
72' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.
71' The total number of attempts is 5:2.
69' Toulouse have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

68' This shall not pass! Rafik Messali (Toulouse) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Toulouse will have a corner.
67' It looks like Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) saw red with that tackle. Stephanie Frappart won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

66' Kendry Paez (Strasbourg) latches onto the ball in the penalty box and takes a first-time effort that goes a couple of yards over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
65' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
64' Emersonn (Toulouse) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
62' Substitution. Kendry Paez (Strasbourg) in, Andrew Omobamidele out.
62' Liam Rosenior has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mathis Amougou (Strasbourg) replacing Sebastian Nanasi.
61' A player from Strasbourg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
61' Ben Chilwell (Strasbourg) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.

60' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. The ball is out of play. Strasbourg will have a throw-in.
58' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Guillaume Restes, who smothers the ball.
58' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
56' Rafik Messali (Toulouse) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
55' Wonderful movement by Toulouse. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
53' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
51' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
50' A cross into the box from Guela Doue (Strasbourg) is cleared.
49' Alexis Vossah (Toulouse) commits a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for an infringement.
48' Rafik Messali (Toulouse) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
46' Half-time substitution. Carles Martinez decided to make a change. Frank Magri is replaced by Rafik Messali (Toulouse).
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Frank Magri (Toulouse) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
43' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
42' The Toulouse players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
40' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Stephanie Frappart no option but to blow his whistle.
38' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
36' Strasbourg are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
32' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
32' Frank Magri (Toulouse) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
28' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) receives a yellow card.

27' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
25' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
22' Strasbourg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
18' 1 - 0 Goal! Emersonn (Toulouse) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:0.
18' Emersonn (Toulouse) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the right side of the net, but the effort is smothered by the keeper.

18' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Strasbourg are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
14' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
13' Toulouse are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

11' Emersonn (Toulouse) rifles a low drive from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic reflex save.
9' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) attempts to head the rebound low into the middle of the goal, but Guillaume Restes reads his intention and makes an incredible reflex save!
7' Ben Chilwell (Strasbourg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Toulouse.
6' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
5' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is behind the touchline and Toulouse will take a throw-in.
3' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) commits a rough foul. Stephanie Frappart stops the game and makes a call.
